title: Short dep IDs persisted without canonicalization
description:
Repro:
  kbs dep stoney-47f48a blocked-by stoney-82e6da
  kbs validate

Result:
  dependency target 'stoney-82e6da' does not exist

Both prefixes uniquely identified valid issues and other commands accepted them. Full UUID for the target worked.

Expected: Resolve unique prefixes to full IDs before persistence, or reject short IDs instead of writing an invalid dependency.
right_now_summary: Short dependency IDs are saved without expansion, so validation cannot find valid targets.
